title: Spellbreak · Break the screen trance on macOS
description: A Mac menu bar break timer that washes every display in moving aurora light. Hold 2-3 seconds to leave early, or turn on Lock mode so the break runs its clock.
ogTitle: Spellbreak · Full-screen aurora breaks for macOS
ogDescription: Turn a chosen interval into a full-screen pause across every Mac display. Call-aware via Core Audio, zero network access, one-time purchase.
